title: Flowermate V5.0S Vaporizer
description:
Who’s the Flowermate V5.0S for?

The V5.0S dry herb vaporizer is a great choice for someone looking for an affordable, easy to use, well made, portable vaping experience at a great price point.

Vapor quality

The Flowermate V5.0S’s airflow is comfy and the vapor is smooth. Even with the short, isolated air path of a portable, the glass stem does a nice job cooling the vapor. The V5.0S keeps the flavor nice and strong while giving you about 10-15 draws from a fully loaded chamber.

Even vaporization

The Flowermate uses conduction heat to vaporize your aromatic blends. The ceramic heating chamber is specifically designed to ensure your material is evenly vaporized with no stirring.

Impressive battery life

The Flowermate V5.0S is powered by two high-quality 18650 batteries which deliver up to 2 hours 30 minutes of vaporization. This is some of the best battery life of any portable vaporizer on the market. Also, the v5.0S features a 6-minute auto-shutoff to preserve battery life and USB charging allowing you to power up almost anywhere.

Works worldwide

The Flowermate charges via USB so it will work anywhere in the world. Charge using any USB wall plug, power bank or even computer if in a pinch.

Low maintenance

Cleaning the Flowermate is easy. Just brush out the oven and chamber screens after use and use a cotton swab with Isopropyl alcohol if there is build up.

Simple

The Flowermate V5.0S dry herb vaporizer features a convenient single power button which controls both the power and temperature range. Vaporizing with the Flowermate is truly simple. Load the chamber and then turn the unit on. Within 30 seconds the unit is ready to vape.

Three preset temperature settings

The V5.0S has 3 ideal vaporization temperature settings at 385 ° F / 195 ° C , 400 ° F / 205 ° C and 415 ° F / 212 ° C . Don’t worry about your technique, the temperature controls are programmed so that you will never combust.

Check out the user manual for a full rundown.

Quality construction

The Flowermate features a ceramic heating chamber, Pyrex stem, and an anodized aluminum shell in your choice of 6 colors.

Pocket size

The Flowermate easily tucks away in your pocket and looks like a power bank. The loading chamber and stem are hidden in sliding compartments for a discreet look and very little odor can be detected when not in use.

Read our in-depth review of the V5.0S

Flowermate’s colorful V5.0S is as easy on the lungs as it is on the wallet, and it’s a great entry entryway into vaporizers

User manual

Download the Flowermate V5.0S manual here.

Warranty

We are authorized dealers of Flowermate vaporizers. Your vape will come with a 1-year manufacturer’s warranty against defects and 90 days on the batteries. You will need your device’s serial number to be eligible for warranty work, which can be located on the back of the box on a sticker. As with everything purchased from Planet Of The Vapes, you are also covered by our 100% Satisfaction Guarantee.
